overloadMerges.note: value is documented with the '←' arrow (returned by the command), not '→'; auto-parse defaulted it to direction 'in'.

params.name: command
params.description: Command number, from the QR Commands constant theme

params.name: value
params.description: Value of the selected sub-item, if any (e.g. the selected font name for the Font menu command, or a color number for a color menu command)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns whether the toolbar command is enabled (1) or disabled (0), and optionally the currently selected sub-item value via value; typically called either as a standalone status check, or inside the method installed by QR ON COMMAND (where $1 is the area reference and $2 the command number).
